subject: Request: keep Asteron pilot active — procurement delay
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@asteronlabs.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.example.com
Cc: procurement@asteronlabs.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot access — procurement is taking longer than expected

Hi Mina,

Quick update from our side: finance flagged a requirement for an updated vendor questionnaire and the supplier onboarding team has queued us behind two larger vendors. We were expecting a PO by next Tuesday but it looks like it may slip into next week.

We're two-thirds of the way through the evaluation and the product team has a couple of demos left they want to run with the pilot dataset. Can Redwood keep the pilot environment live for another week while procurement finishes the PO? If not feasible, can we get a short-term voucher or sandbox credits so the team doesn't lose momentum?

I've attached the current purchase_order_draft.pdf so you can see the expected terms. Appreciate any flexibility here — this pilot is high-priority for our roadmap.

Thanks,
Jordan Ellis
Head of Product
Asteron Labs

Attachments: purchase_order_draft.pdf (PDF)

From: mina_haddad@redwood.example.com <mina_haddad@redwood.example.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@asteronlabs.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.example.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot access — procurement is taking longer than expected

Jordan — thanks for the context and for sending the PO draft.

We can absolutely help avoid any interruption. Two quick options:

- Short-term: I can provision a 7-day sandbox voucher (equivalent to ~150k tokens) today to keep your engineers running demos and evals. No payment required up front.
- Longer runway: If procurement can confirm a PO date, we can place a temporary hold policy on your pilot so it doesn't auto-terminate while legal/finance finish onboarding. That requires an expected PO date and the PO draft you attached helps.

If you want the voucher now I can send it and loop in Sean from Renewals to track the PO and close the deal. Which would you prefer?

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Email: mina_haddad@redwood.example.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

Also FYI I've asked procurement to route the PO as 'urgent' and I've included a note explaining this keeps our evaluation from stalling.

After the voucher is applied, I'll also enable a non-billing grace hold so the workspace doesn't auto-suspend if the PO comes through within 10 days. We'll need the expected PO date and the PO draft for our records.

Jordan / Procurement team — voucher issued and workspace set to grace-hold. Details below: 

- Voucher: AST-KEEP-7D-XXXXX (redeem via the console, expires 2027-05-31 23:59 PT) — 7 days / 150k-token equivalent
- Grace hold: workspace will not auto-suspend for 10 days; if PO clears before 2027-06-03 we'll invoice against the PO as discussed
- Action items: Jordan to confirm the expected PO date and procurement approver; Procurement to send final PO to finance@redwood.example.com when available

Jordan — happy to extend further if the PO date slips again; we prefer to align extensions with an action plan (PO date, approver, and a short milestone schedule for the next demos).

Thanks — Mina
